name: The Safety Net
summary: A flat big top where artists pass metric chips mid-air; the Checkout chip slips, a net of data lines catches it and the ringmaster decides.
look: Flat, elegant circus in deep ink with radiating tent panels and soft spotlights. Faceless geometric artists on amber trapeze bars pass teal metric chips; a thin teal data-line net with a central knot (the Acme mark) catches the one coral chip.

components.name: Big-top stripes
components.role: flat radiating tent panels; the stage

components.name: Trapeze artists
components.role: faceless geometric silhouettes on pendulum bars; the team

components.name: Metric chips
components.role: rounded mono tokens, teal when fine, coral when slipping

components.name: Data-line net
components.role: thin teal mesh with knots; the agent, invisible until needed

components.name: Catch ripple + callout
components.role: rings from the caught knot; the callout carries the anomaly

motion.name: Pendulum
motion.how: bar rotation ±22°, sine.inOut, one swing per two bars at 120 BPM; passes on the 'and' of beat 4

motion.name: Net catch
motion.how: mesh sags 40 px then recovers with elastic.out(1, 0.35) over 0.9 s; ripple ring expands over one beat

motion.name: Rebound toss
motion.how: corrected chip rides an arcing motion path in 0.8 s with one spin, landing on a downbeat

story: Hook: 'Shipping on Friday. Without a net?' Artists juggle ever more chips until Checkout tilts and falls toward an empty ring. Reveal: on the drop the net unrolls from the Acme-mark knot and a teal 'Acme Pulse' banner drops in. Proof: the Checkout chip slips mid-pass, the net sags and ripples, the callout reads 'Checkout conv. −18% · 09:42 · deploy #2231', and the ringmaster taps Roll back to toss it back up. CTA: 'You ship. Pulse watches.' under the spotlight, chips back in the air, Start free.
adapt: Name the chips after what your team juggles (invoices, releases, tickets) and label the net's knots with the rules your product checks.

fit.risk: Can imply the team keeps dropping things; frame the slip as the world changing mid-air (a deploy), not human failure.
